name: Post-rasterization Smearing
definition: An alternative to smearing each individual sample during rasterization; uses a separate buffer to accumulate a velocity vector for each voxel, then smears the entire buffer in a single step after rasterization/splatting is complete.
summary: Post-rasterization smearing approximates motion blur by accumulating velocity in a separate buffer and applying a single global smear pass after rasterization, differing from methods that smear individual samples during the process.
